definitions.explanation: Abbreviation of {国際連合|こくさいれんごう}. The international organization established in 1945 to promote peace, security, and cooperation among nations.

examples.japanese: {国連|こくれん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{総会|そうかい}→総会：13855_soukai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{開|ひら}かれた→開く：01979_hiraku⟧。
examples.english: A UN General Assembly session was held.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{国連|こくれん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{加盟国|かめいこく}→加盟国：19160_kameikoku⟧だ。
examples.english: Japan is a member state of the United Nations.

examples.japanese: {国連|こくれん}{安全保障理事会|あんぜんほしょうりじかい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{緊急|きんきゅう}→緊急：11327_kinkyuu⟧⟦{会合|かいごう}→会合：02605_kaigou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|ひら}いた→開く：01979_hiraku⟧。
examples.english: The UN Security Council held an emergency meeting.

notes:
USAGE:
Abbreviation of ⟦{国際連合|こくさいれんごう}→国際連合：18107_kokusairengou⟧. {国連|こくれん} is the standard form used in news and everyday conversation. The full form ⟦{国際連合|こくさいれんごう}→国際連合：18107_kokusairengou⟧ appears mainly in formal documents.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {国連|こくれん}⟦{総会|そうかい}→総会：13855_soukai⟧: UN General Assembly
- {国連|こくれん}⟦{安保理|あんぽり}→安保理：18113_anpori⟧: UN Security Council (abbreviated)
- {国連|こくれん}{事務総長|じむそうちょう}: UN Secretary-General
- {国連|こくれん}⟦{加盟国|かめいこく}→加盟国：19160_kameikoku⟧: UN member state
- {国連|こくれん}{平和|へいわ}{維持|いじ}{活動|かつどう}: UN peacekeeping operations (PKO)
